where: The Old Light, floor 3 — Intermission (the tea-urn floor, a rest point)
mood: Intermission — a swung tea-room lounge tune; the urn whistles and the flute scoops into its long notes.
_note: Classic oldlight-f3: 100 swung, B-flat. Restful but still comic. Opening: a breathy flute trill like a whistling tea urn over a walking bass already moving.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
breathy flute lead that scoops up into its long notes
cosy tea-room interval, gentle and funny
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a breathy flute trill like a tea urn coming to the boil, over a walking bass and brushes that are already strolling}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the Punchwheel tune slowed to a swung lounge on flute over walking bass and soft organ sevenths; at phrase ends two sleepy vibraphone giggles}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {again with a muted trumpet answering the flute softly, organ swells under, still relaxed}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a dreamy turn to E-flat major, celesta and flute trading little phrases, the bass ambling, then a vibraphone run home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lounge tune returns on flute; the last bar's walking bass strolls straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
